description.Name: Synthetic 3D Brain MRI Dataset from a Glioma Cohort

latestSnapshot.readme:
# Synthetic 3D Brain MRI Dataset from a Glioma Cohort

This dataset contains synthetic 3D T1-weighted contrast-enhanced
(T1CE) brain MRI volumes trained from RSNA-ASNR-MICCAI-BraTS-2021 
(DOI: 10.7937/jc8x-9874).

Each synthetic subject has one MRI volume.

The images have been organized into a BIDS-compatible structure.

The BIDS T1w suffix is used for the contrast-enhanced T1-weighted
anatomical images.

IMPORTANT:
These images are synthetic.
